text: For this model, assume all seven days of the week are equally likely birth days. Choose one person at random. Write the sample space in weekday order, starting with Monday. Separate the seven days with commas.
sourceFile: Sample Space and Relative Frequency Test.docx
html:
For this model, assume all seven days of the week are equally likely birth days. Choose one person at random.

Write the sample space in weekday order, starting with Monday. Separate the seven days with commas.

Equal birth-day probabilities are a modelling assumption for this exercise.
answerHtml:
Worked solution

The seven outcomes are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Under the stated model each has probability 1/7.
